description: Lightricks LTX Retake — re-generate any section of an existing video (audio, video, or both) without starting over.

input_video.description: Existing video URL to retake a section of. At least 73 frames (~3s), max 4K.

prompt.description: Optional description of what should happen in the retaken section.

start_time.description: Start time in seconds of the section to regenerate.

duration.description: Duration in seconds of the section to regenerate. Minimum 2s.

retake_mode.description: What to replace in the selected section.

resolution.description: Output resolution. If omitted, auto-detected from input orientation.
